message.text: MemoService uses gRPC plus grpc-gateway (REST) and ConnectRPC. I am locating the exact files for each protocol's registration.

Key files located. Examining v1.go and connect_handler.go to identify the two protocols and their registration paths.

Likely protocols are gRPC-Gateway (REST) and ConnectRPC. Checking v1.go for a native gRPC server registration.

One protocol is gRPC-Gateway (REST). It is registered in server/router/api/v1/v1.go via RegisterMemoServiceHandlerServer. The second protocol is still being identified.

The second protocol is ConnectRPC. Its registration and wrapping happen in connect_handler.go and connect_services.go. The APIV1Service embeds UnimplementedMemoServiceServer to implement the gRPC service interface for both protocols.

Checking whether native gRPC is actually served, since the comment in connect_handler.go claims support for both native gRPC and Connect.

message.text:
The two protocols are Connect RPC and gRPC-Gateway. The gRPC-Gateway registration is in server/router/api/v1/v1.go via RegisterMemoServiceHandlerServer. The Connect RPC registration path was not found.

Connect RPC registration is in server/router/api/v1/connect_handler.go via NewMemoServiceHandler and RegisterConnectHandlers.

q19.
gRPC-Gateway — server/router/api/v1/v1.go
Connect RPC — server/router/api/v1/connect_handler.go

`RegisterMemoServiceHandlerServer` in `v1.go` mounts the REST gateway. Connect wrapping/registration is `ConnectServiceHandler.RegisterConnectHandlers` (`apiv1connect.NewMemoServiceHandler`) in `connect_handler.go`; adapter methods live in `connect_services.go`.
